_comment: Labels every managed repo has ('all'), Peras's control labels on every repo in peras-repos.json ('peras-repos', design 7.12, 7.13), plus a repo's own. The issue forms add their label; the automation adds needs-fields, settings-drift, claude-md-drift, ai-scorecard and automation-failures; a person adds confirmed (design 6.1). apply-rules.py creates or updates them, verify-settings.py checks name, colour and description. Labels not listed (GitHub's defaults) are left alone.

all.name: triage
all.description: Bug not yet triaged into an intent or a task

all.name: confirmed
all.description: A person checked this critical or high audit finding's evidence (design 6.1)

all.name: deferred
all.description: Audit finding deferred to a later phase, with the reason on the issue

all.name: needs-fields
all.description: Missing or invalid form answers; kept out of planning views

all.name: release

all.name: ready-to-merge
